takes.title: Balance an object at the forehead
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands above the forehead, bends and steps with the head held back, then spreads the arms for balance. The source identifies an object balanced at the forehead.

takes.title: Motorcycle pose with arms extended
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a staggered stance with soft knees and both arms extended forward as if reaching for handlebars.

takes.sourceDescription: flip and stand on one hand
takes.title: One-handed inverted balance
takes.actionDescription: The performer reaches down, swings the legs overhead into a brief one-handed balance, then lowers the legs separately and steps away.

takes.sourceDescription: spins, flips, stand on one hand
takes.title: Spins and one-hand acrobatics
takes.actionDescription: The performer links turns and quick setup steps with flips and a one-hand balance, then comes upright through a bent-knee recovery.

takes.title: Inverted spins, handstands, and flips
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short approaches and standing resets with inverted turns, handstands, and flips, returning upright at the end.

takes.title: Balance-beam walk and corrections
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes narrow steps with arms extended, varies the arm height as the feet cross and the body turns, then steps out. The source identifies a balance beam.
